notes.text: Rif reproduces the case from the Jerusalem Talmud at 52a:9 and carries the remainder across the leaf. The checked Rif has Shishna, whereas the Warsaw form is Shashna.
Both the Yerushalmi and Rif expressly identify the son of R. Shmuel as the one to be circumcised. They also use a plural verb for forgetting the knife.
The exact parallel gives why the circumcision was deferred to the next day.
The direct Jerusalem Talmud has Rav Shasha’ah as the child whose circumcision was deferred.
